beaches.name: Park Point Beach House
beaches.coordinateNote: Park Point Beach House shoreline reference, approximate; not a parking pin
beaches.story: At Park Point, the city gives way to a long ribbon of sand between Duluth Harbor and Lake Superior. Wind off the open lake can feel strikingly different from sheltered streets. Face the open lake, then turn toward the harbor. These neighboring waters have different exposure. Notice which direction the breeze comes from and how waves arrive before settling onto the sand.

safety.name: Minnesota Lake Superior Beach Monitoring Program

beaches.name: Big Bay State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: Approximate park shore reference; not a ferry dock or entrance
beaches.story: Madeline Island's sandstone shore opens to Lake Superior. The beach and wooded boardwalk offer very different shelter from wind, even within a short walk. Walk from the wooded boardwalk toward the shoreline and notice when the shelter falls away. That change in wind can tell you more about comfort than a single inland temperature.
beaches.accessAlert: The park reports construction closures affecting the beach parking lot from September 8, 2026 through approximately June 30, 2027. Check current park conditions before travel.

beaches.name: Kohler-Andrae State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: Approximate lakefront reference, not an exact swim-area entrance
beaches.story: Wooded trails and dune grasses give way to a long, open sweep of Lake Michigan. A breeze that barely stirs the pines may be more noticeable on the sand. Pause where dune grass gives way to open beach. A breeze crossing Lake Michigan may feel different from the air among the pines. Compare the forecast with the wind you meet here.

beaches.name: Point Beach State Forest
beaches.coordinateNote: Park-level reference, not an exact swim-area entrance
beaches.story: Six miles of beach edge the forest. Where trees stop and open water begins, the breeze and the sounds of Lake Michigan become the weather story. Listen for the change from forest sounds to waves. Trees can soften wind that is moving freely over the lake. Consider both settings when choosing how long to stay.

beaches.name: North Avenue Beach
beaches.coordinateNote: Illinois BeachGuard beach-center coordinate, not a parking pin
beaches.story: The city skyline rises behind the sand, but the lake sets its own pace. A lake breeze can cool an exposed walk after a warm afternoon inland. Chicago's buildings warm and shelter the streets, while the open lake follows its own rhythms. If the wind blows onshore, notice whether the air changes as you approach the water.

beaches.name: Illinois Beach State Park North Beach
beaches.coordinateNote: Illinois BeachGuard beach-center coordinate, not a trailhead
beaches.story: This rare stretch of natural Illinois lakefront carries dunes, wetland habitat and wide views over Lake Michigan. Leave the tree line and pay attention to the wind. Look from the dunes and wetland habitat toward the horizon. Each part of the shore meets the wind differently. Use the official beach information independently of the weather.

beaches.name: West Beach, Indiana Dunes National Park
beaches.coordinateNote: Indiana water-quality monitoring coordinate; the visitor entrance is elsewhere
beaches.story: Climb toward the dunes and you can see how much shoreline the lake controls. The open beach is less sheltered than the woods and stairs behind it. On a visit through the dunes, notice where the stairs or wooded approaches give way to the full reach of lake wind. Check the park's current access information before you set out.

beaches.name: Indiana Dunes State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: Indiana beach-monitoring station coordinate, not a parking pin
beaches.story: Dune ridges rise beyond a wide sandy strand. Wind crossing Lake Michigan meets a landscape of exposed shore, protected hollows and forest. The dune ridges offer pockets of shelter, but the waterline opens to the breeze. Watch the direction of the waves and ask what part of the forecast applies to this exact setting.

beaches.name: Edgewater Beach
beaches.coordinateNote: USGS shoreline monitoring coordinate; not an entrance
beaches.story: Just beyond Cleveland's streets, the beach faces a broad stretch of Lake Erie. The open water and exposed sand can change how a day feels without changing the city forecast. Cleveland's skyline is the backdrop; Lake Erie is the weather-making foreground. Compare the wind among the streets with what you feel on the open sand.

beaches.name: Maumee Bay State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: USGS park-water reference east of marina, not a beach entry or monitored swim-area pin
beaches.story: Here Lake Erie meets marsh, meadow and shore. The western basin is shallow, and the experience may change quickly as clouds and wind pass across the bay. The marshes and exposed shore offer two neighboring experiences of the same afternoon. Look for the direction the air is moving, and remember that shallow water does not establish safe swimming.

beaches.name: Presque Isle State Park, Beach 6
beaches.coordinateNote: USGS Beach 6 East monitoring reference; not a lifeguard or parking location
beaches.story: On Presque Isle's sandy peninsula, Lake Erie is always close. The breeze you feel beyond the dunes may differ from conditions back in Erie. This peninsula turns the shoreline toward different winds. Study the waves reaching your section of beach before choosing where to linger and check the current posted guidance.
beaches.accessAlert: Swimming is permitted only at designated guarded areas when officially open. Check current staffed beaches and posted restrictions.

beaches.name: Evangola State Park Beach
beaches.coordinateNote: New York State beach-program monitoring coordinate, not entrance
beaches.story: A broad sandy shore runs beneath the Lake Erie sky. Notice what the wind is doing over open water before settling in for the afternoon. Step back and watch how the waves reach this broad sandy beach. A clear sky does not tell you what the water is doing. Read the park's current notices.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality

beaches.name: Woodlawn Beach State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: New York beach-program monitoring coordinate, not entrance
beaches.story: Near the eastern end of Lake Erie, the shore opens into sky and sand. A steady lake wind can make the air feel different than it does a few streets back. The lake breeze may feel different from the air a few blocks inland. Compare wind direction with the water's surface rather than assuming the town forecast is a beach measurement.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality

beaches.name: Hamlin Beach State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: New York beach-monitoring reference, not precise parking location
beaches.story: Lake Ontario stretches north from these broad beaches. A clear inland morning is only part of the story; the open water and the afternoon breeze matter here. Lake Ontario fills the northern horizon. Watch clouds move above the water and notice whether wind reaches the beach from the lake or across the park.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality

beaches.name: Fair Haven Beach State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: New York beach-monitoring reference; not a trail entrance
beaches.story: High bluffs and sandy shoreline share a small corner of Lake Ontario. At water level you meet a different wind exposure than on paths above the beach. The bluff and beach give two levels from which to experience the same lake. Wind exposure may differ between them. Check the issued forecast and the shoreline itself.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality

beaches.name: Southwick Beach State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: New York beach-monitoring reference; not an entrance
beaches.story: Dunes, marshland and a long sand beach line the eastern shore of Lake Ontario. At the lake edge, wind and cloud cover change the rhythm of a visit. The dunes and marsh frame a long sweep of sand. Notice where the grass shelters you and where the open Lake Ontario breeze becomes more apparent.
beaches.accessAlert: Consult the park for current parking, beach access and any seasonal notices.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality
